note: This file is a pure configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It defines ImageNet dataset settings including data preprocessing parameters, augmentation pipelines (train/test), and dataloader configurations for batch size 64 with AutoAugment policies.
data_preprocessor: Image normalization parameters (mean, std, RGB conversion) for 1000-class ImageNet
train_pipeline: Training augmentation pipeline with RandomResizedCrop, RandomFlip, AutoAugment (imagenet policies), and PackInputs
test_pipeline: Evaluation pipeline with ResizeEdge, CenterCrop (224), and PackInputs
train_dataloader: Training dataloader config: batch_size=64, num_workers=5, DefaultSampler with shuffle=True
